title.en: Unit 1203 S2 Ep.1 — Night of the Sirens: One Flat Minute

_note: 시즌 2 첫 화. 13화 투표 결과가 비어 있어 A(집에 머문다)를 '민수의 선택'으로 썼다. 참고 시트는 시즌 2용(s2_minsu, s2_grandma)만 쓴다. 효과음은 sting/rumble/siren/radio/click/thunk/hum만.

beats.ko: 사이렌이 울린 지 40초. 민수는 창가에 서 있었어요.
beats.en: Forty seconds since the sirens started. Minsu was standing at the window.

tts.ko: 사이렌이 울린 지 사십 초. 민수는 창가에 서 있었어요.

beats.ko: 1년 전 3주 정전을 버틴 민수지만, 이 소리는 처음이었죠.
beats.en: He had lived through a three-week blackout a year ago. This sound was new.

tts.ko: 일 년 전 삼 주 정전을 버틴 민수지만, 이 소리는 처음이었죠.

beats.ko: 휴대폰엔 벌써 소문이 떴어요. 훈련이래, 오발령이래.
beats.en: The phone was already full of rumors. A drill, they said. A false alarm.

beats.ko: 민수는 거실 불을 다 켜고, 창문을 활짝 열어 하늘을 내다봤어요.
beats.en: Minsu turned on every light in the living room and threw the window wide open to look at the sky.

beats.en: A knock at the door. It was Grandma, with a bag on her shoulder and a radio in her hand.
beats.prompt: Dim apartment hallway at night lit by one amber emergency light, the grandma (gray hair bun, half-moon glasses, muted ochre cardigan, cane) standing at an open door with a small packed backpack on her shoulder and a battery radio in her hand, calm steady face; Minsu (dark brick-red hoodie, big round glasses) in the doorway, the bright room behind him. beats.en: Lights off, she said. And close the window.

beats.en: Listen, she said. One flat minute of siren is an alert warning. It means get ready.

key.en: ONE FLAT MINUTE = ALERT, GET READY

tts.ko: 할머니는 말했어요. 평탄하게 일 분이면 경계경보, 준비하라는 거야.

beats.en: If it rises and falls like a wave, that's an air-raid warning. Then you go underground, right away.

key.en: RISING, FALLING SIREN = AIR RAID, GO DOWN

tts.ko: 물결치듯 오르내리면 공습경보. 그때는 바로 지하야.

beats.ko: 민수는 소문 대신 재난문자를 열었어요. 경계경보 발령, 대피 준비.
beats.en: Minsu closed the rumors and opened the emergency alert. Alert warning issued. Prepare to evacuate.
beats.prompt: Close-up of Minsu's hands (dark brick-red hoodie sleeves) holding a phone in a dark room, the screen showing a plain emergency alert banner with a bold warning triangle icon and empty text lines, no readable text, the cold screen light on his hands. beats.ko: "경계경보엔 할 일이 있어. 아이와 노인부터 대피 준비, 불 날 것 치우고, 밤이면 불빛 안 새게."
beats.en: An alert warning has its own list, she said. Children and the elderly get ready first. Put away anything that can catch fire. And at night, let no light leak out.

tts.ko: 경계경보엔 할 일이 있어. 아이와 노인부터 대피 준비, 불 날 것 치우고, 밤이면 불빛 안 새게.

beats.en: Minsu turned off the lights, sat against the inner wall away from the window, and switched on the radio.

beats.en: Tonight there is one thing he can do. Listen.

beats.en: Four in the morning. The radio spoke. Alert warning lifted.
